chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Chapter 148: Red Eggs, Family Secrets, and the Masked Land Ahead
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang departs Siqi, learns the rules of "seeing but not saying," and faces the next unknown: the Later Shu, where masked Nuo opera performers might be hiding more than just their faces.
og_title: A Stolen Sword, a Pregnant Daughter-in-Law, and a Country That Loves Masked Operas
og_description: Our survivors finally leave Siqi behind—only to realize Li Huowang can’t even read the next country’s name on the map. Lü Zhuangyuan celebrates a potential grandson. A dark seed about Nuo opera is planted.
twitter_title: Chapter 148: The Later Shu — Where the Masks Come Out
twitter_description: Li Huowang leaves one nightmare country and heads straight for another he can’t even read the name of. Plus: red eggs, family drama, and Nuo opera’s unsettling origin.
